description: Put a note or a logged activity on a Salesforce record (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Case …): kind "activity" (default) creates a completed Task ("Log a Call"/e-mail) that shows in the record's activity timeline; kind "note" creates an Enhanced Note (ContentNote) linked to the record. A call summary belongs in the CRM, not only here. WRITES — permission gate + write log; dry run unless the connection is live.

dry_run.description: true = build and log the request but send nothing. Writes are ALWAYS dry runs while the tenant's Salesforce connection has write_mode "dry_run" (the default).

kind.description: activity = completed Task in the timeline (default), note = Enhanced Note

subject.description: title / subject (default: first line of body)

name: add_salesforce_note
